text: Precision Approach Runway Category 3A is intended for operations down to an RVR of the order of 200 meters, no decision height being applicable using visual aids during the final phase of landing. B is intended down to an RVR of the order of 50 meters, no decision height being applicable using visual aids for taxiing. What is the minimum standard for Category 3A operation?
